prepared_by: Codex automation; not user confirmation or user-performed verification
operational_note: The current train.py CLI does not read this JSON. This is a proposal for review, not an executed or approved run configuration.

required_review: The shared end-to-end data, training, validation and checkpoint flow
The unverified assumption that the course-derived slice labels preserve the source IDs
The fixed training budget, checkpoint selection, metric aggregation and resource measurement scopes
confirmation_gate.additional_pre_run_work: After confirmation and before any formal run, add and check separate training, validation and checkpoint-restoration resource instrumentation. Resolve any data-check errors before training.

scope.existing_smoke_records: Preserve the existing baseline and Improved smoke evidence unchanged; do not relabel smoke epochs or results as formal experiments.

training.selection: all training pairs; no train-limit subset

validation.selection: all validation pairs after every complete training epoch

data.grouping_note: Existing filename audits find no overlap in numeric case groups. These are patient-group proxies, not independently verified real-patient identities.
data.evidence_basis: Counts and grouping come from existing train/validation audits; preparing this proposal does not itself rerun those audits.
pre_run_requirements: Finite and matching MRI/mask Affine matrices under the documented tolerance
Finite MRI values and integer raw mask IDs in 0..5
Record and compare identical training and validation manifest hashes for both models
data.spatial_claim_boundary: Matching shape and Affine do not independently prove anatomical alignment, physical units or medical annotation accuracy.

labels.working_assumption: The current keras_slices_data course derivative preserves the original source label IDs. In particular, its ID5 is interpreted as prostate only under this explicit assumption.
labels.claim_boundary: Do not infer labels from display colors, numeric magnitude, model behavior or old scores. Other classes or foreground macro Dice cannot substitute for the target-organ Dice.

preprocessing.normalization: per-slice min-max over all MRI pixels, before padding; constant images become zero
preprocessing.sample_padding: zero-pad bottom/right to the next multiple of 16
preprocessing.batch_padding: zero-pad bottom/right to the maximum padded height and width in the current batch
preprocessing.valid_region: all original pixels, including class0 and black MRI pixels; padding excluded from loss and metrics
preprocessing.prediction_crop: crop the final prediction to each sample's original height and width without interpolation
preprocessing.padding_note: Convolutions and Improved InstanceNorm still see padded image values. Identical preprocessing and batching are required; padding invariance of predictions is not claimed.

shared_protocol.shuffle: same seeded training selection/order policy with a dedicated DataLoader generator; validation is not shuffled
shared_protocol.initialization_note: Use each current architecture's existing initialization. The same seed does not create identical initial weights across different architectures.
shared_protocol.validation: eval mode, gradients disabled and no optimizer updates; accumulate metrics across the entire validation split
shared_protocol.fairness_rule: Do not change input handling, loss, precision, optimizer, batch size or budget for only one model. A required protocol change must be reviewed and applied to both before restarting a comparable experiment.

training_budget_and_failure_policy.budget_basis: 11460 training slices / batch4 = 2865 batches; 20 complete epochs = 57300 updates per model
training_budget_and_failure_policy.on_failure: Preserve evidence, mark the run incomplete and report the failure. Do not silently reduce batch size or change one model's settings.
training_budget_and_failure_policy.completion_rule: A model run with fewer than 20 complete epochs is incomplete. If either model is incomplete, do not present the pair as a completed final fair comparison.

primary_report.organ_interpretation: Prostate only under the explicit course-derived ID-preservation assumption
primary_report.aggregation: Sum the entire validation split's valid-pixel confusion counts first, then compute ID5 Dice. This is not an average of batch Dice or per-case Dice.

secondary_reports: Pixel-pooled Dice and IoU for each of the six raw classes
Foreground macro Dice and macro IoU excluding raw ID0 and undefined classes
Valid-pixel cross-entropy over the entire validation split
metrics_and_model_selection.absent_class_policy: A class absent from both prediction and reference is undefined (null) and omitted from macro means. False-positive predictions on an empty reference score zero.

checkpoint_selection.tie_break: earliest epoch; replace best only on a strictly lower validation CE
checkpoint_selection.preserved_rule: Keep the current shared CE checkpoint selection rule; the reported primary ID5 Dice does not silently replace the selection criterion.
checkpoint_selection.restore_check: Reload the selected checkpoint with its model metadata and verify the saved selected-epoch reference logits before reporting it.

metrics_and_model_selection.old_metric_boundary: This proposal uses the current pixel-pooled metric, not the old project's case-balanced mean of per-volume prostate Dice. Do not substitute old 0.8316/0.8233 values for new results or compare them as if the metric and experiment were unchanged.

resource_measurement_proposal.instrumentation_status: not yet implemented or checked for this formal protocol

memory.method: Synchronize CUDA and reset peak counters at each stage boundary; record both peak allocated and peak reserved bytes for that stage.
memory.report_resident_state: State whether the model, optimizer state, gradients, input/output tensors and restored model are resident in each stage. Resident optimizer state must not be silently excluded from a validation or restoration peak.
memory.old_smoke_boundary: Existing smoke peaks include checkpoint restoration. Preserve those recorded scopes; do not relabel them as isolated training peaks or total GPU VRAM.

inference.input: fixed seeded synthetic tensors; no test pixels
inference.timing: Synchronize CUDA before and after each measured model forward. Report median and p95 batch milliseconds and disclose the percentile method.
inference.included: Resident model and input, forward computation and its host launch/synchronization overhead
inference.excluded: Checkpoint loading, disk I/O, host/device transfers, metric calculation and plotting
inference.resident_optimizer: No optimizer in the isolated inference profile; report this explicitly.

resource_measurement_proposal.environment: Record GPU, Python/PyTorch/CUDA versions, device and deterministic/benchmark settings for each actual run; no cross-environment bitwise reproducibility claim.

later_evaluation_boundary.prerequisite: Select and freeze both models using training/validation, then separately establish and authorize the final evaluation boundary.
later_evaluation_boundary.prior_exposure: The user and Codex have already encountered old test results. The test set must not be described as never seen, and those results must not guide tuning.
later_evaluation_boundary.publication: No authorization here for a new PR, replacement of the old PR, force-push or changes to the original repository.

academic_and_evidence_boundary: The proposal, automated checks and future commits do not establish user understanding, tutor check-off completion or originality-hurdle approval.
